content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-t03-ekt24vm5/report.rdl

Drop the Equipment Type column from the table.

I removed the Equipment Type column from FleetTable. Its header and detail cells are gone, and the remaining columns are Asset Name, Site, Operating Hours, Idle Hours, and Utilization.

I also reduced the table's overall width from 6in to 5in so it matches the five remaining 1in columns.

The underlying dataset still returns the EquipmentType field. I left it in place because nothing else in the report needed it; say if you want it dropped from the query too.

The validation warnings were already present and aren't caused by this change: two unused data sources (LegacySQL, ScratchPowerQuery), DateFrom and DateTo typed as String, and a Utilization field the DAX query doesn't appear to return.
